context: In this case, the security definition for hierarchical AB-IPFE can be obtained by treating it as an FE scheme. Specifically, the key generation oracle is augmented with the ability to output skỹ given ỹ as input, or to output sky given y as input, in addition to outputting skỹ,y given (ỹ, y) as input. skỹ is treated as a secret key that can fully decrypt ciphertexts satisfying relation R, while sky is treated as a secret key that can compute inner product values for ciphertexts of any attribute. 3.2 Hierarchical Structure in Existing AB-IPFE Table 2 summarizes the hierarchizability of existing AB-IPFE schemes. Both hierarchical structures can be added to ACGU20sel and NPP22. ET25 and the lattice-based schemes can be augmented with the attribute-on-top hierarchy, but adding the vector-on-top hierarchy to them appears difficult. Constructing an LWE-based AB-IPFE scheme with the vector-on-top hierarchy remains an open problem. The hierarchizability of ACGU20ad depends on the underlying function encoding. We discuss this point in the next section. Example 1 (ACGU20sel). ACGU20sel [ACGU20] is based on predicate encodings. Let KP denote the key generation function of the underlying predicate encoding P.
